name: memcpy_triton
description: Copy a slice between 2-D tensors. dim must be 0. With offset_src=True, dst[:sz]=src[offset:offset+sz]; otherwise dst[offset:offset+sz]=src[:sz]. offset and sz are one-element device int32 tensors loaded inside the kernel, not Python integers. For distinct dst/src storages the kernel writes dst in place and returns the same dst tensor. If dst and src share storage, it instead returns a newly allocated tensor and leaves dst unchanged. Current tests exercise bfloat16 with rows*cols up to 4096*2048 and both offset_src values.
